name: AK18A - Portable Carbon Monoxide Detector & Alarm (CO), Electrochemical Sensor, 39g Pocket Size
highlights: Carbon Monoxide That Travels With You — Hotel rooms, rented flats, boats, caravans, workshops — the places most likely to have an unserviced appliance are exactly the places with no CO alarm fitted.
Electrochemical Sensing at 39 Grams — A safety-grade electrochemical cell in a body lighter than a set of keys.
Audible and Visual Alert — The reading is on screen continuously; the alarm sounds when it crosses the threshold.
500 mAh, Rechargeable — USB-C, about an hour to full — no proprietary cells to source when it goes flat.
100 Per Carton — 433 × 348 × 222 mm outer, 11 kg gross. At 39 g a unit, the cheapest safety product in the catalogue to ship.
